detail.igNotBusiness: The Instagram account is not a Business account. Reconnect with a Business or Creator account.
detail.igError: There was an error connecting the Instagram account. Please try again.
detail.igLinkRevoked: This connection link was revoked or has expired. Ask your agency for a new one.
detail.igCancelled: The connection was cancelled before finishing. Click Connect again and accept the requested permissions.
detail.igMissingPermissions: Some required permissions were not granted. Reconnect the account keeping all permissions checked.
detail.igStateExpired: The connection session expired. Click Connect again to start over.
detail.igRestricted: Meta flagged a restriction on this account. Open the Instagram app, resolve any pending warnings, and try again.
detail.igRateLimited: Meta temporarily limited the attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
detail.igOffMetaIntro: The Meta account you tried to connect has "activity outside Meta technologies" turned off, which blocks connections from external apps like Mesaas. Whoever manages the account needs to change this in Accounts Center:
detail.igOffMetaStep1: On Instagram or Facebook, open Settings, then Accounts Center (or go to accountscenter.facebook.com).
detail.igOffMetaStep2: Go to "Your information and permissions", then "Activity outside Meta technologies".
detail.igOffMetaStep3: Open "Manage future activity" and enable "Connect future activity".
detail.igOffMetaStep4: Wait a few minutes and try connecting Instagram again.

connect.title: Connect Instagram
connect.intro: {{agency}} asked to connect {{client}}'s Instagram to Mesaas.
connect.explain: Continuing takes you to Instagram to sign in and authorize access. Neither Mesaas nor the agency sees or stores your password.
connect.successBody: The account @{{username}} is connected. You can close this page.
connect.alreadyBody: The account @{{username}} is already connected. Nothing to do here.
connect.invalidBody: This link does not exist. Check the address or ask your agency for a new one.
connect.revokedBody: The agency revoked this link. Ask for a new one to continue.
connect.expiredBody: This link is past its expiry date. Ask your agency for a new one.
connect.unavailableBody: Instagram connection is not available for this agency at the moment. Contact whoever sent you the link.
connect.startError: Could not open Instagram. Please try again in a moment.
connect.mobileNoticeIntro: On a phone, the Instagram app may open on its own and get stuck here.
connect.mobileNoticeRecovery: If that happens: tap the ◀ Chrome or ◀ Safari arrow in the top left corner to go back, then tap Connect again. The second attempt usually stays in the browser.
connect.mobileNoticeDesktop: On a computer, this does not happen.
connect.generate: Generate a link for the client
connect.dialogIntro: Send this link to the client. They authorize Instagram without needing a Mesaas login.
connect.sendError: Could not send the email. Please try again.
connect.revokeConfirm: Revoke this link? Anyone who already has it will no longer be able to use it.
connect.generateError: Could not generate the link. Please try again.
